fn ReduceByFactors235(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (n > 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 1) then 1 else if ((n % 2) == 0) then ReduceByFactors235((n / 2)) else if ((n % 3) == 0) then ReduceByFactors235((n / 3)) else if ((n % 5) == 0) then ReduceByFactors235((n / 5)) else n))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (ReduceByFactors235(1) == 1)
  example (ReduceByFactors235(7) == 7)
{
  if (n == 1) then 1 else if ((n % 2) == 0) then ReduceByFactors235((n / 2)) else if ((n % 3) == 0) then ReduceByFactors235((n / 3)) else if ((n % 5) == 0) then ReduceByFactors235((n / 5)) else n
}

fn MinMovesToOne(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (n > 0)
  requires (ReduceByFactors235(n) == 1)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 1) then 0 else if ((n % 2) == 0) then (1 + MinMovesToOne((n / 2))) else if ((n % 3) == 0) then (2 + MinMovesToOne((n / 3))) else if ((n % 5) == 0) then (3 + MinMovesToOne((n / 5))) else 0))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (MinMovesToOne(1) == 0)
  example (MinMovesToOne(2) == 1)
{
  if (n == 1) then 0 else if ((n % 2) == 0) then (1 + MinMovesToOne((n / 2))) else if ((n % 3) == 0) then (2 + MinMovesToOne((n / 3))) else if ((n % 5) == 0) then (3 + MinMovesToOne((n / 5))) else 0
}

fn Solve(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (n > 0)
  ensures (result >= -1)
  ensures ((result == -1) == (not (ReduceByFactors235(n) == 1)))
  ensures ((not (result >= 0)) or ((ReduceByFactors235(n) == 1) and (result == MinMovesToOne(n))))
  effects pure
  example (Solve(0) == 0)
{
  0
